status_summary: No executive or legislative action returning civilian investigations to OPM was found for 2025-01-20 through 2026-10-11. A GAO statement to a House Oversight subcommittee on 2026-02-24 says DCSA conducts about 95 percent of government background investigations, around 2 million a year, and that DOD projects finishing NBIS modernization by the end of FY2027 and retiring legacy systems in FY2028; the legacy systems still reside on OPM's network under interagency agreements. The same statement reports that the target for completing the Trusted Workforce 2.0 vetting reforms moved from the end of FY2026 to the end of FY2028; this concerns vetting reform rather than which agency conducts investigations. DefenseScoop reported on 2026-02-25 that DCSA had an acting director and that an updated estimate projects about 2.2 billion dollars more for NBIS through FY2031.

timeline.event: GAO testifies to the House Oversight Subcommittee on Government Operations that DCSA conducts about 95 percent of government background investigations and that DOD projects finishing NBIS modernization by the end of FY2027.
